intervals.label: hosting the Palo Verde neutrino experiment
intervals.note: Start is the first month of the neutrino experiment's data set; the plant itself is older and its commissioning dates were not sourced. The interval is open because no source consulted says the plant has stopped.
intervals.quote: The experiment was performed at the Palo Verde Nuclear Generating Station in Arizona.

name: Palo Verde Nuclear Generating Station
notes: Reactor power: "The plant consists of three identical pressurized water reactors with a total thermal power of 11.63 GW" (PRD 64, 112001).

summary.plain: The largest nuclear power station in the United States, in the Arizona desert, with three reactors; a shallow underground laboratory about 800 metres from them housed the Palo Verde neutrino experiment in 1998-2000.
summary.technical: Palo Verde Nuclear Generating Station, Maricopa County, Arizona: three identical pressurised-water reactors with a total thermal power of 11.63 GW; host of the Palo Verde reactor-antineutrino oscillation experiment (750 m and 890 m baselines).
